item.title: Apple Touch‑Screen MacBook Pro Expected Oct‑Nov Launch
item.description: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says Apple will debut OLED touch‑screen 14‑ and 16‑inch MacBook Pros this fall, featuring M5 Pro/Max chips and Dynamic Island.

item.title: MacBook Ultra: OLED Touchscreen Elevates Premium Class
item.description: Apple’s rumored MacBook Ultra adds an OLED touchscreen, hinge, Dynamic Island and a slimmer chassis, placing it above the M5 Pro/Max MacBook Pros.
